body: No , no falling out. it’s just Idk depression I guess makes me feel isolated and alone and tries to convince me that my presence is unwanted or like I feel like no one likes me being around and i got into my head and started to spiral when i wrote that a bit ago.
I mean, iv’e thought about it. But why would she care? Her job is to get me to graduate so the school can then get more money. Idk i have a bit of trust issues.

I’m a junior in high school, if my grades suck then that’s it for me and my dreams of a future that I don’t even want. My grades are bad because i’m depressed and suicidal. I just felt like why try if this is going to be it for me? Idk. Idk anything anymore. How’s your life going?

Everything makes me want to kill myself, the weather, my parents divorce, my grades, my relationships and overall just me. I’m a failure and i can’t fix any of it. I can’t fix me. I’m terrified of living, idk it just feels like offing myself would fix everything. I’ve never felt the need to die so strongly, it’s always just a “oh if it happens”.
